40	// Factory for Cassandra backend.
41	type Factory struct {
42		Options *Options
43	
44		metricsFactory metrics.Factory
45		logger         *zap.Logger
46		tracer         trace.TracerProvider
47	
48		config config.Configuration
49	
50		session cassandra.Session
51	
52		// tests can override this
53		sessionBuilderFn func(*config.Configuration) (cassandra.Session, error)
54	}
55	
56	// NewFactory creates a new Factory.
57	func NewFactory() *Factory {
58		return &Factory{
59			Options:          NewOptions(),
60			sessionBuilderFn: NewSession,
61		}
62	}
63	
64	// InitFromOptions initializes factory from options.
65	func (f *Factory) ConfigureFromOptions(o *Options) {
66		f.Options = o
67		f.config = o.GetConfig()
68	}

70	// Initialize performs internal initialization of the factory.
71	func (f *Factory) Initialize(metricsFactory metrics.Factory, logger *zap.Logger, tracer trace.TracerProvider) error {
72		f.metricsFactory = metricsFactory
73		f.logger = logger
74		f.tracer = tracer
75		session, err := f.sessionBuilderFn(&f.config)
76		if err != nil {
77			return err
78		}
79		f.session = session
80	
81		return nil
82	}
83	
84	// createSession creates session from a configuration
85	func createSession(c *config.Configuration) (cassandra.Session, error) {
86		cluster, err := c.NewCluster()
87		if err != nil {
88			return nil, err
89		}
90	
91		session, err := cluster.CreateSession()
92		if err != nil {
93			return nil, err
94		}
95	
96		return gocqlw.WrapCQLSession(session), nil
97	}
98	
99	// newSessionPrerequisites creates tables and types before creating a session
100	func newSessionPrerequisites(c *config.Configuration) error {
101		if !c.Schema.CreateSchema {
102			return nil
103		}
104	
105		cfg := *c // clone because we need to connect without specifying a keyspace
106		cfg.Schema.Keyspace = ""
107	
108		session, err := createSession(&cfg)
109		if err != nil {
110			return err
111		}
112	
113		sc := schema.NewSchemaCreator(session, c.Schema)
114		return sc.CreateSchemaIfNotPresent()
115	}
116	
117	// NewSession creates a new Cassandra session
118	func NewSession(c *config.Configuration) (cassandra.Session, error) {
119		if err := newSessionPrerequisites(c); err != nil {
120			return nil, err
121		}
122	
123		return createSession(c)
124	}

126	// CreateSpanReader implements storage.Factory
127	func (*Factory) CreateSpanReader() (spanstore.Reader, error) {
128		return nil, errors.New("not implemented")
129	}

131	// CreateSpanWriter creates a spanstore.Writer.
132	func (f *Factory) CreateSpanWriter() (spanstore.Writer, error) {
133		options, err := writerOptions(f.Options)
134		if err != nil {
135			return nil, err
136		}
137		return cspanstore.NewSpanWriter(f.session, f.Options.SpanStoreWriteCacheTTL, f.metricsFactory, f.logger, options...)
138	}

140	// CreateDependencyReader creates a dependencystore.Reader.
141	func (f *Factory) CreateDependencyReader() (dependencystore.Reader, error) {
142		version := cdepstore.GetDependencyVersion(f.session)
143		return cdepstore.NewDependencyStore(f.session, f.metricsFactory, f.logger, version)
144	}

146	// CreateLock implements storage.SamplingStoreFactory
147	func (f *Factory) CreateLock() (distributedlock.Lock, error) {
148		hostId, err := hostname.AsIdentifier()
149		if err != nil {
150			return nil, err
151		}
152		f.logger.Info("Using unique participantName in the distributed lock", zap.String("participantName", hostId))
153	
154		return caslock.NewLock(f.session, hostId), nil
155	}
156	
157	// CreateSamplingStore implements storage.SamplingStoreFactory
158	func (f *Factory) CreateSamplingStore(int /* maxBuckets */) (samplingstore.Store, error) {
159		samplingMetricsFactory := f.metricsFactory.Namespace(
160			metrics.NSOptions{
161				Tags: map[string]string{
162					"role": "sampling",
163				},
164			},
165		)
166		return csamplingstore.New(f.session, samplingMetricsFactory, f.logger), nil
167	}
168	
169	func writerOptions(opts *Options) ([]cspanstore.Option, error) {
170		var tagFilters []dbmodel.TagFilter
171	
172		// drop all tag filters
173		if !opts.Index.Tags || !opts.Index.ProcessTags || !opts.Index.Logs {
174			tagFilters = append(tagFilters, dbmodel.NewTagFilterDropAll(!opts.Index.Tags, !opts.Index.ProcessTags, !opts.Index.Logs))
175		}
176	
177		// black/white list tag filters
178		tagIndexBlacklist := opts.TagIndexBlacklist()
179		tagIndexWhitelist := opts.TagIndexWhitelist()
180		if len(tagIndexBlacklist) > 0 && len(tagIndexWhitelist) > 0 {
181			return nil, errors.New("only one of TagIndexBlacklist and TagIndexWhitelist can be specified")
182		}
183		if len(tagIndexBlacklist) > 0 {
184			tagFilters = append(tagFilters, dbmodel.NewBlacklistFilter(tagIndexBlacklist))
185		} else if len(tagIndexWhitelist) > 0 {
186			tagFilters = append(tagFilters, dbmodel.NewWhitelistFilter(tagIndexWhitelist))
187		}
188	
189		if len(tagFilters) == 0 {
190			return nil, nil
191		} else if len(tagFilters) == 1 {
192			return []cspanstore.Option{cspanstore.TagFilter(tagFilters[0])}, nil
193		}
194	
195		return []cspanstore.Option{cspanstore.TagFilter(dbmodel.NewChainedTagFilter(tagFilters...))}, nil
196	}
197	
198	var _ io.Closer = (*Factory)(nil)
199	
200	// Close closes the resources held by the factory
201	func (f *Factory) Close() error {
202		if f.session != nil {
203			f.session.Close()
204		}
205	
206		return nil
207	}

209	func (f *Factory) Purge(_ context.Context) error {
210		return f.session.Query("TRUNCATE traces").Exec()
211	}
212	
213	func (f *Factory) IsArchiveCapable() bool {
214		return f.Options.ArchiveEnabled
215	}
216	
217	func (f *Factory) GetSession() cassandra.Session {
218		return f.session
219	}

128		}

130		if err != nil {

132		}

36	type tableMeta struct {

48	func (t *tableMeta) materialize() {
49		t.insertStmt = fmt.Sprintf(t.insertStmt, t.tableName)
50		t.queryByKindStmt = fmt.Sprintf(t.queryByKindStmt, t.tableName)
51		t.queryStmt = fmt.Sprintf(t.queryStmt, t.tableName)
52	}

54	var schemas = map[schemaVersion]tableMeta{
55		previousVersion: {
56			tableName:       "operation_names",
57			insertStmt:      "INSERT INTO %s(service_name, operation_name) VALUES (?, ?)",
58			queryByKindStmt: "SELECT operation_name FROM %s WHERE service_name = ?",
59			queryStmt:       "SELECT operation_name FROM %s WHERE service_name = ?",
60			getOperations:   getOperationsV1,
61			createWriteQuery: func(query cassandra.Query, service, _ /* kind*/, opName string) cassandra.Query {

68			queryByKindStmt: "SELECT span_kind, operation_name FROM %s WHERE service_name = ? AND span_kind = ?",

77	// OperationNamesStorage stores known operation names by service.
78	type OperationNamesStorage struct {
79		// CQL statements are public so that Cassandra2 storage can override them
80		schemaVersion  schemaVersion
81		table          tableMeta
82		session        cassandra.Session
83		writeCacheTTL  time.Duration
84		metrics        *casmetrics.Table
85		operationNames cache.Cache
86		logger         *zap.Logger
87	}
88	
89	// NewOperationNamesStorage returns a new OperationNamesStorage
90	func NewOperationNamesStorage(
91		session cassandra.Session,
92		writeCacheTTL time.Duration,
93		metricsFactory metrics.Factory,
94		logger *zap.Logger,
95	) (*OperationNamesStorage, error) {
96		schemaVersion := latestVersion
97		if !tableExist(session, schemas[schemaVersion].tableName) {
98			if !tableExist(session, schemas[previousVersion].tableName) {
99				return nil, fmt.Errorf("neither table %s nor %s exist",
100					schemas[schemaVersion].tableName, schemas[previousVersion].tableName)
101			}
102			schemaVersion = previousVersion
103		}
104		table := schemas[schemaVersion]
105		table.materialize()
106	
107		return &OperationNamesStorage{
108			session:       session,
109			schemaVersion: schemaVersion,
110			table:         table,
111			metrics:       casmetrics.NewTable(metricsFactory, schemas[schemaVersion].tableName),
112			writeCacheTTL: writeCacheTTL,
113			logger:        logger,
114			operationNames: cache.NewLRUWithOptions(
115				100000,
116				&cache.Options{
117					TTL:             writeCacheTTL,
118					InitialCapacity: 10000,
119				}),
120		}, nil
121	}
122	
123	// Write saves Operation and Service name tuples
124	func (s *OperationNamesStorage) Write(operation dbmodel.Operation) error {
125		key := fmt.Sprintf("%s|%s|%s",
126			operation.ServiceName,
127			operation.SpanKind,
128			operation.OperationName,
129		)
130		if inCache := checkWriteCache(key, s.operationNames, s.writeCacheTTL); !inCache {
131			q := s.table.createWriteQuery(
132				s.session.Query(s.table.insertStmt),
133				operation.ServiceName,
134				operation.SpanKind,
135				operation.OperationName,
136			)
137			err := s.metrics.Exec(q, s.logger)
138			if err != nil {
139				return err
140			}
141		}
142		return nil
143	}

145	// GetOperations returns all operations for a specific service traced by Jaeger
146	func (s *OperationNamesStorage) GetOperations(
147		query tracestore.OperationQueryParams,
148	) ([]tracestore.Operation, error) {
149		return s.table.getOperations(s, query)
150	}

152	func tableExist(session cassandra.Session, tableName string) bool {
153		query := session.Query(fmt.Sprintf(tableCheckStmt, tableName))
154		err := query.Exec()
155		return err == nil
156	}
157	
158	func getOperationsV1(
159		s *OperationNamesStorage,
160		query tracestore.OperationQueryParams,
161	) ([]tracestore.Operation, error) {
162		iter := s.session.Query(s.table.queryStmt, query.ServiceName).Iter()
163	
164		var operation string
165		var operations []tracestore.Operation
166		for iter.Scan(&operation) {
167			operations = append(operations, tracestore.Operation{
168				Name: operation,
169			})
170		}
171		if err := iter.Close(); err != nil {
172			err = fmt.Errorf("error reading operation_names from storage: %w", err)
173			return nil, err
174		}
175	
176		return operations, nil

184		if query.SpanKind == "" {
185			// Get operations for all spanKind
186			casQuery = s.session.Query(s.table.queryStmt, query.ServiceName)
187		} else {
188			// Get operations for given spanKind
189			casQuery = s.session.Query(s.table.queryByKindStmt, query.ServiceName, query.SpanKind)
190		}
191		iter := casQuery.Iter()
192	
193		var operationName string
194		var spanKind string
195		var operations []tracestore.Operation
196		for iter.Scan(&spanKind, &operationName) {
197			operations = append(operations, tracestore.Operation{
198				Name:     operationName,
199				SpanKind: spanKind,
200			})
201		}
202		if err := iter.Close(); err != nil {
203			err = fmt.Errorf("error reading %s from storage: %w", s.table.tableName, err)
204			return nil, err
205		}
206		return operations, nil
207	}

## Summary

**1. `GetSpanKind` function** — `internal/storage/v1/cassandra/spanstore/dbmodel/model.go`: added `GetSpanKind(ds *Span) string` that returns the `ValueString` of the first tag whose `Key == model.SpanKindKey`, else `""`.

**2. `CoreSpanWriter` interface + signature change** — `internal/storage/v1/cassandra/spanstore/writer.go`:
- Added the `CoreSpanWriter` interface (`WriteSpan(ds *dbmodel.Span) error`, `Close() error`) with a compile-time `var _ CoreSpanWriter = &SpanWriter{}`.
- Changed `WriteSpan` to accept only `*dbmodel.Span` (dropped the `context.Context` + `*model.Span`); updated `writeSpanToDB`/`writeIndexes` accordingly, switching span-kind lookup to `dbmodel.GetSpanKind(ds)` and duration time to `model.EpochMicrosecondsAsTime`.
- Removed the firehose flag check so all spans are indexed.

**3. Mock** — `internal/storage/v1/cassandra/spanstore/mocks/mocks.go`: added a testify-pattern `CoreSpanWriter` mock (`WriteSpan`, `Close`) matching the existing `CoreSpanReader` style.

**4. `TraceWriter`** — new `internal/storage/v2/cassandra/tracestore/writer.go`: `TraceWriter{writer spanstore.CoreSpanWriter}` implementing `tracestore.Writer`; `WriteTraces` uses `ToDBModel` + `errors.Join`, `Close` delegates, and `NewTraceWriter` constructs it (propagating the "neither table..." error).

**5. v2 factory** — `internal/storage/v2/cassandra/factory.go`: moved `writerOptions(opts *cassandra.Options)` here and rewired `CreateTraceWriter` to build options and call `ctracestore.NewTraceWriter`, propagating both errors.

**6. v1 factory** — `internal/storage/v1/cassandra/factory.go`: removed `CreateSpanReader`, `writerOptions` (and the now-obsolete `CreateSpanWriter`, which no longer compiled after the signature change) plus unused imports.

**7. Fixed caller** — `savetracetest/main.go` now calls `WriteSpan(dbmodel.FromDomain(getSomeSpan()))`.

Note: existing `_test.go` files that used the old `WriteSpan(ctx, span)` signature will be updated by the verification system's test patches, as instructed.
